msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. The model must be a completely different woman from anyone in the reference: a new face and a different hairstyle; never reproduce the face or likeness of a real person from the reference. If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia maria-antonia-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a beige faux-fur jacket over a long beige jumpsuit with a wide brown belt and a grey beret from the reference, walking at the Gothic cathedral of Burgos, Spain, seen from a sunny square, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia maria-antonia-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a burgundy long cardigan over a burgundy and grey tartan maxi skirt from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
